Pipeline readiness validated at 12k (6/7 checks PASS, zoom_coherence borderline at 0.50) and 28k checkpoint (hier_impr=0.67). Production deployment at 174k scale BLOCKED pending legal-distance delivery of ACCEPTED 174k dense embeddings (currently 3/26 years). TF-IDF representations at 174k FAIL hierarchical_v1 legal_structure_branch (1/4 modes PASS — only regeste_tfidf at 83k sample). No clustering algorithm overcomes TF-IDF signal density deficit at 174k scale.
